Enrichment 2026-10-06. Per-scene moves: 01-readme gathers (attract/implode — the encounter plane receives); a formation walks the gateway's own three relations Agency→AgentSession→ActuationStream before settling on 'gateway'; a pointerStrength LFO lets the plane breathe. 02-ql-relational-system-prompt settles into the relation: 'Relational'→'Logos' crosses the centre in one slow step (3.2s hold); z here is the relation's own depth — self nearest, logos between, Other deepest (the prompt's 'self ↔ logos ↔ Other'). 03-readme holds (guard — the constitution states what agency has been brought into being).

Pointers: gather on the gateway, stillness on the relation scene, guard on the constitution — encounter receives, relation rests, bounds hold. Layout line throughout (the records' own term rows).
